key_insight: MTSF-ANO improves quantum time-series forecasting by replacing fixed local measurements with adaptive non-local observables, increasing model expressivity.
engineering_relevance: The approach suggests a practical hybrid quantum-classical design that can yield better multivariate forecasting accuracy without changing the core variational circuit framework.
method: Uses a variational quantum circuit as the forecasting backbone.
Adds adaptive non-local observables instead of fixed local measurements.
Tunes circuit design and observable non-locality through ablation-guided evaluation.
evidence_signal: On four ETT datasets, the method ranks first or second in MSE in 17 of 20 settings and improves over the strongest baseline by up to 20% on ETTh1.
watch_item: The gains depend on observable design and circuit choices, so performance may be sensitive to implementation details and dataset setting.
paper_title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Adaptive Non-Local Observables
